name: TOT Order Diagnostics Tool
description: Look up Shopify, BigCommerce, or WooCommerce orders directly and run excise tax troubleshooting checks. Shopify: 9 checks incl. TOT tags, PMD, tax jurisdiction match, live price check, plus 2 conditional checks (excise vs. compliance sheet, Net 30/B2B payment terms). BigCommerce (beta): verification status, excise tax line item incl. jurisdiction/compliance cross-check, payment/address/coupon/cart checks. WooCommerce (step 1): order fetch + raw custom-field display, diagnostics not yet built. HQ Excise Tax scan (proposed): automates the Active Monitoring order sweep against the internal Excise Tax Order API across multiple client orgs.
